text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.desc.pulse: Pulse rotation effect. The highlight is controlled by alpha. The very tip of the pulse has an alpha of 1.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.desc.spaci: Like a dashed line, flashes with intervals.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.desc.flat: Only translucent base color, no other effects.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.desc.stati: Only opaque base color, no other effects.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.ch: Specific configurations for different beacon levels
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.mi: Mixes in some white to make the visual effect brighter
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.sp: Opacity of the highlighted parts in interval mode
Opacity of the gap parts in interval mode
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.mo: This level does not exist in vanilla Minecraft. Requires integration with other server-side mods to work.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.co: The halo is tinted according to the beacon beam colors. From outer to inner rings, it samples the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th... block of the beam color. If the interval is 2, it samples 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th... block color, and so on.
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.pa: View dynamic effects (will run in-game time)
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.title.prev: Previewing, adjust your in-game perspective yourself
text.fabric-blue-archive-halo.tooltip.pr: Clear the interface for a clean preview (In-game only)
